title: Javier Kajika
summary: A Warlords of New York target associated with the Pathway Park main mission in Lower Manhattan.

claims.text: An official Ubisoft feature identifies Pathway Park as Javier Kajika's hiding place.
Ubisoft's Title Update 9.1 recap identifies Javier Kajika as the final encounter of the Pathway Park main mission.

paragraphs.text: Kajika is tied to Pathway Park in Lower Manhattan: Ubisoft identifies the park as his hiding place and separately identifies him as the mission's final encounter.

verification.notes: This entry records only the official Pathway Park association. Personal history, allegiance and later status require separately scoped evidence.
